chunks: God has promised men and women who believe gardens with streams of running water where they will abide for ever, and beautiful mansions in the Garden of Eden, and the blessings of God above all. That will be happiness supreme.
ai.seo_question: What is the ultimate reward for believers according to Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the equality of men and women in spiritual merit and divine reward, highlighting that 'Ridwan' (God's pleasure) is the supreme objective beyond material paradise. The mention of 'Jannat 'Adn' (Everlasting Gardens) underscores the eternal nature of this abode, while the emphasis on God's pleasure reflects the Sufi and philosophical tradition where nearness to the Divine is the ultimate success (Fawz al-Azim).
